comments_data.body: Hi @IanMayo , I just created a concept on how to customize the tooltip text, so for this requirement: we recreate it for each new active element e.g. "route-in", "search" area", "route-out", I think we can create multiple translation files, then we can load the appropriate translation file for specific activity name.

>  I think we can create multiple translation files, then we can load the appropriate translation file for specific activity name.

Yes, that was the only work-around I could think of.  But, we can't hard-code the titles, since they come from the game data.   That doesn't seem to be a problem though - we just clone the object and over-ride the specific command we're about to use.

issues.title: Change labels on GeoMan tooltip
issues.body:
When we enter a GeoMan drawing mode, a tooltip guides the user in what to do (add line, add polygon point, etc): `Click to place first vertex`

But, we do have domain-specific terms for the geometry/feature that the user is adding, such as `Route-in` or `Target Area`.  In `OrderDrawing`, it's in the `current.name` field, as manipulated in the `currentGeometry` useState hood.

GeoMan does include sets of translations that can be used to over-ride the displayed text.  I _think_ we just create a new custom translation that just introduces the term for the current `activity`.   The translation is created when the control-bar is created, but that's ok, because we re-generate it for each new activity element, eg: "route-in", "search area", "route-out".

![animation of create feature](https://i.gyazo.com/af09fa5452a4f133fbb5b281981a30e0.gif)

But, there may be another way of modifying the displayed text.
